class.name: ResonanceRuntime
class.brief_description: Runtime orchestrator: initializes ResonanceServer, applies config, ticks simulation, optional debug overlays.
class.description: Assign a [url=#ResonanceRuntimeConfig]ResonanceRuntimeConfig[/url] to [member runtime]. Initializes [ResonanceServer] via [method get_config_dict], drives the listener-centric Steam Audio tick, and owns optional debug overlays. Bus wiring, reverb activator, and FMOD/Coda bridges are helpers driven from this node. Use one live runtime per game ([method is_primary_runtime]). With [member enable_debug] at runtime, overlay hotkeys work (defaults F1 canvas HUD, F2 performance, F3 player label); keys are configurable and ignored in the editor. After hiding static meshes, prefer [url=#ResonanceRuntimeExporter]ResonanceRuntimeExporter[/url] then [method request_static_scene_reload]. For procedural / RAM probe bakes without the editor, use [url=#ResonanceRuntimeBaker]ResonanceRuntimeBaker[/url].

method.name: get_live_game_runtime_count
method.description: Number of [ResonanceRuntime] nodes currently live in a running game (not editor preview).

method.name: is_primary_runtime
method.description: True when this instance owns the primary Steam Audio init / tick for the session.

method.name: apply_bus_to_players
method.description: Re-applies effective bus routing to all [ResonancePlayer] nodes that follow the global default.

method.name: apply_bus_to_player
method.description: Applies effective bus routing to one [ResonancePlayer] (or compatible node).

method.name: get_bus_effective
method.description: Effective Godot bus for Direct + Pathing. Falls back to Master when unset.

method.name: get_reverb_bus_name
method.description: Bus that hosts the reverb effect and activator. Falls back to ResonanceReverb. Activator feeds only this global bus.

method.name: get_reverb_bus_send
method.description: Target bus the reverb bus sends to (same as [method get_bus_effective]).

method.name: refresh_player_bus_routing
method.description: Recomputes and re-applies bus routing for the reverb bus and all players.

method.name: get_config_dict
method.description: Config passed to [method ResonanceServer.init_audio_engine]: [method ResonanceRuntimeConfig.get_config] plus SIMD/validation and F3 overlay debug flags at init.

method.name: get_frame_timings
method.description: Main-thread tick timing snapshot. Detailed phases only when [member performance_custom_monitors] is Full.

method.name: get_activator_instrumentation
method.description: Debug counters for the reverb-bus activator path.

method.name: get_fmod_bridge
method.description: Active FMOD bridge helper, or null when [member fmod_bridge_enabled] is off.

method.name: get_coda_bridge
method.description: Active Coda bridge helper, or null when [member coda_bridge_enabled] is off or no Coda autoload.

method.name: request_static_scene_reload
method.description: Queues a deferred reload of all [ResonanceStaticScene] packs into the server. Prefer [url=#ResonanceRuntimeExporter]ResonanceRuntimeExporter[/url] after geometry changes.

method.name: perform_deferred_static_scene_reload
method.description: Runs the pending static-scene reload (called after [method request_static_scene_reload]). Scripts rarely call this directly.

method.name: reload_after_reinit
method.description: After [method ResonanceServer.reinit_audio_engine]: reloads probes, source handles, and bus prewarm. Called from config reinit signals.

method.name: deferred_reset_spatial_audio_warmup_passes
method.description: Resets the spatial-output warmup gate on the next frame after geometry/scene handoff.

method.name: notify_volumes_runtime_config_changed
method.description: Notifies probe volumes that runtime config changed (warnings / reload hints).

method.name: warn_probe_volume_runtime_mismatches
method.description: Logs when baked probe data does not match the current runtime reflection/pathing settings.

method.name: prepare_for_shutdown
method.description: Hard-stops players and detaches [ResonanceAudioEffect] so AudioServer can tear down before GDExtension deinit. Call a few frames before quit.

method.name: on_scene_tree_exiting
method.description: Quit path: arms teardown when the scene tree exits. Connected by the runtime; scripts rarely call this.

method.name: on_window_close_requested
method.description: Quit path: arms teardown on window close. Connected by the runtime; scripts rarely call this.

method.name: on_native_engine_reinit_requested
method.description: Handles [signal ResonanceRuntimeConfig.native_engine_reinit_requested]. Scripts rarely call this.

method.name: on_runtime_live_config_changed
method.description: Handles [signal ResonanceRuntimeConfig.runtime_live_config_changed] (live patch without full reinit).

method.name: on_runtime_routing_changed
method.description: Handles [signal ResonanceRuntimeConfig.runtime_routing_changed] (bus refresh).

method.name: on_bake_ambisonic_order_changed
method.description: Handles [signal ResonanceRuntimeConfig.bake_ambisonic_order_changed] (probe mismatch warnings).

members.member: [url=#ResonanceRuntimeConfig]ResonanceRuntimeConfig[/url] for simulation and bus names. Engine init uses [method get_config_dict]. Empty creates a default at runtime.
Creates the FMOD bridge at init for [ResonanceFmodEventEmitter]. Requires the FMOD Godot integration; see docs/FMOD_BRIDGE.md.
Creates the Coda bridge at init for [ResonanceCodaEventEmitter]. Requires a CodaRuntime autoload named Coda.
Steam Audio SIMD: Default (-1), AVX-512, AVX2, AVX, SSE4, or SSE2. Changing after init may need an audio engine restart.
Steam Audio API validation (debug only; adds overhead). Changing after init may need a restart.
Master switch for runtime debug overlays. When false, overlay keys are ignored and overlays hide. Always ignored in the editor.
Key for the canvas debug overlay while [member enable_debug] is true. Default F1.
Key for the performance overlay while [member enable_debug] is true. Default F2.
Key for the per-player 3D HUD while [member enable_debug] is true. Default F3.
Godot debugger custom monitors: Off, Core, Standard (default), or Full. Full fills detailed [method get_frame_timings] phases.
